title: LibZ Reafabricated
description: Unofficial port of LibZ by Globox_Z for newest minecraft versions
body:
# LibZ Refabricated

**Unofficial port of [LibZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/libz) by [Globox_Z](https://modrinth.com/user/Globox1997) — ported to Minecraft 1.21.11 with Mojang Mappings (Fabric).**

All credit for the original mod goes to **Globox_Z**.

Required dependency for **LevelZ Refabricated**.

## About LibZ

LibZ is a library mod used by several mods originally developed by Globox_Z.

It provides shared systems, utilities and APIs used by dependent mods, reducing duplicated code and simplifying development and maintenance.

One of its main features is the tab registry system used for visible screen tabs and configurable interfaces.

This mod is intended as a dependency and does not add major standalone gameplay content.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c7e053aced60c79f32739e26758cdc5314aae08.jpeg)

## What's changed in this port

- Ported to Minecraft 1.21.11
- Migrated from Yarn to Mojang Mappings
- Updated dependencies
- Adapted for Minecraft 1.21.11 compatibility

## Requirements

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
